notes: The package-lock.json at base_commit remains byte-for-byte unchanged; the generated Dockerfile verifies its recorded SHA256 before npm ci --ignore-scripts, retaining the original installation policy.

The common Pi template uses source workspace mode and the SHA256-pinned published catalog. Its 40 catalog files are byte-identical to the prior environment/model-data.tar.gz; that archive is retained for historical reproduction but is no longer a build input.

Source mode preserves the original task contract and does not build dist. The frozen Pi source and lock have an existing build:offline TS2322 in google-shared.ts; no Pi source or dependency version is changed to hide that failure.
Actual retained image identity and executed runtime evidence are recorded separately; metadata changes do not assert a successful build.
